books.title: The Story of Saint Charbel
books.summary: Our flagship saint in the new storybook art style: ten sourced pages from the mountains of Bekaa Kafra to the hermitage of Annaya, with gentle read-aloud narration and points of reflection.
books.coverAlt: Painterly illustration from the new Saint Charbel storybook: a young mother with her small son beside a cedar tree in a Lebanese mountain village above the clouds

books.title: The Story of Saint Charbel (Classic Edition)
books.summary: Our first storybook, kept just as it was made: the boy from the Lebanese mountains who became the hermit of Annaya - a 27-page classic about prayer, silence, and a life hidden with God.
books.coverAlt: Illustration from the Saint Charbel storybook: a child kneels in prayer in the snow outside a stone chapel in a mountain village at sunrise

books.title: The Story of Saint Rafqa
books.summary: A girl from Himlaya becomes a sister who teaches, protects a child, and learns to receive care in illness.
books.coverAlt: Painterly illustration of young Boutroussieh with her mother in a Lebanese hillside village

books.title: The Story of Saint Nimatullah
books.summary: Youssef of Hardin became a monk, taught the young Charbel, and learned to care for the people beside him.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative painterly scene of young Youssef and his family in a Lebanese mountain village

books.title: Saint Marina: The Girl Who Became Brother Marinos
books.summary: A girl follows her father to a mountain monastery, is blamed unfairly, and keeps her faith. Read and listen together.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative painterly scene of a young monk at a monastery gate in the Qadisha Valley

books.title: Saint Maroun: The Hermit on the Hill
books.summary: A hermit lives under the open sky, and a whole family of faith grows from his prayer. Read and listen together.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative painterly scene of Maroun praying on a limestone hilltop at dawn beside a small tent

books.title: The Story of the Massabki Brothers
books.summary: Three brothers serve their neighbors. Their story remembers a sad night honestly and helps children choose safety, kindness, and peace.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative portrait of Francis, Mooti, and Raphael Massabki in a Damascus courtyard

books.title: The Story of Saint Joseph
books.summary: Joseph cares for Mary and Jesus through journeys, hard decisions and everyday family life.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative illustration of Joseph with Mary and Jesus in an imaginative family scene

books.title: The Story of Saint Peter
books.summary: A fisherman follows Jesus, learns forgiveness after a painful mistake, and grows in courage.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative illustration of Simon and Andrew mending fishing nets by the lake

books.title: Mary Magdalene: Called by Name
books.summary: A disciple stays close to Jesus and carries the news of his resurrection. Read and listen together.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative illustration of Mary Magdalene beside the lake in Galilee

books.title: Saint Jude: A Question at the Table
books.summary: An honest question, an answer about love, and room for your own questions. Ten narrated reader pages.
books.coverAlt: Jude and Jesus in an imaginative first-century scene

books.title: Saint Augustine: The Restless Heart
books.summary: A clever boy searches for years, and his mother never stops praying. Read and listen together.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative painterly scene of Monica and the boy Augustine on a rooftop in Tagaste

books.title: Sergius and Bacchus: Two Friends Who Stood Together
books.summary: Two friends in the emperor's guard make one hard choice together. Read and listen together.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative painterly scene of two Roman officers, Sergius and Bacchus, standing side by side in a palace colonnade

books.title: The Story of Saint Francis of Assisi
books.summary: From Assisi to a life of simple living, neighborly care, creation praise and peace.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative illustration of young Francis at a cloth shop in Assisi

books.title: The Story of Saint Anthony
books.summary: From Lisbon to Padua, Anthony learns from Scripture and helps others through teaching, prayer and care.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative illustration of young Fernando with his family in Lisbon

books.title: The Story of Saint Therese
books.summary: From Alencon to Lisieux, a young Carmelite learns the little way of trust and everyday love.
books.coverAlt: Imaginative illustration of young Therese Martin with her family in Alencon

books.title: The Story of Padre Pio
books.summary: The boy from Pietrelcina who became a friar and spent his life helping people come back to God - a story of prayer, kindness, and courage.
books.coverAlt: Illustration from the Padre Pio storybook: a young boy looks out over an Italian hill town and a small stone chapel at sunset

books.title: The Story of John Paul II
books.summary: Lolek from Wadowice, who lost so much and kept on loving - the boy who became a pope and told the whole world: do not be afraid.
books.coverAlt: Illustration from the John Paul II storybook: a father and son walk hand in hand toward church in a Polish town at sunset

books.title: The Story of Mother Teresa
books.summary: From a childhood in Skopje to classrooms and care in Calcutta - a story of practical love, prayer, and many helping hands.
books.coverAlt: Painterly illustration from Mother Teresa's storybook showing young Gonxha and her family in Skopje
